title: Share courses with participants → Learner Portal
intro: Semester → Courses → Share with participants → Learner Portal. Evidence for moving a course from setup to learner access, and making the first visit useful. Group assignment belongs to 04; reports to 08; announcements and material delivery to 09. Screens are research captures, not verification of current product capabilities.

questions.title: Publish model (single toggle vs. per-item visibility vs. scheduled release)
Access grant paths (enrolled groups / link / code / email) and how permission levels are expressed
Learner course home: what is above the fold (next session, progress, materials, announcements)
Feedback to instructor that sharing worked (who has opened, pending invites)
